capabilities: Capture quick notes to a searchable timeline
Filter notes by text, tag, and date
Pin, star, and archive useful notes
Receive notes from a WeChat bot
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not sync with the Memos app; notes are stored locally as ordinary Obsidian Canvas files.
extras: Source Available License: commercial use requires separate authorization. No telemetry; WeChat capture disabled by default; no default hotkeys; requires Obsidian 1.7.2+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Memos-style place to jot a passing thought and later find it by text, tag, or date while keeping it in the vault.

relations.evidence: Connect a desktop WeChat ClawBot bot and send text, images, or files to UNmemos

summary: Memos-inspired flash-capture plugin that saves quick notes as Canvas files in a searchable timeline with tags, filters, pins, and optional WeChat capture.
